name: Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, IRCTC is a Navratna (Category 1, Central Public Sector Enterprises ) and the only company authorized by the Indian government to provide online railway tickets, catering services, and packaged drinking water at railway stations and trains in India[1]
keyPoints: Business segments:[1] A) Catering (46% in FY26 vs 27% in FY22): IRCTC runs onboard catering, station food services and e-catering. It serves 63 Cr+ meals a year from 800+ kitchens, with AI-based quality monitoring.[2]
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 37.1%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 49.0%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.36 times its book value
